title: Can a 5 × 4 × 3 m oven accommodate 120 loading trolleys?
summary: A Suneng oven proposal for cross-flow fan impellers targets 120 transfer-rack frames per batch in a 5 × 4 × 3 m chamber. A loading drawing must verify that quantity: frame arrangement, projecting parts, loading access and blockage of side or bottom air outlets cannot be assessed from total chamber volume alone.
